tasks.final_text: Hello, my name is Nick Mendez. One of my favorite places to shop at SCHEELS, it is an outdoors store in the rocky mountain area. It is such a vibe and it has a chick-fil-a right in front of it so I like to go eat there with friends once we are done shopping.

The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. it is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissarist store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
